proof_logic: For each parameterized quadratic graph family, sparse modular elimination at the literal point selects 990 column rows and one additional augmented row. Reconstruction over the full rational parameter ring gives a nonzero constant 990-by-990 column determinant and a nonzero constant multiple as the 991-by-991 augmented determinant. Therefore the target defect is outside the entire degree-at-most-four completion span at every parameter value.
conclusion: None of the five single-defect quadratic graph-coordinate families z7,z9,z10,z11,z12 admits a one-stage target completion of degree at most four restoring degree at most three.
scope: The multi-defect z8 family at target degree four is not covered. Nor are cubic graph corrections, nonlinear target coordinates, or ordered multi-stage automorphisms.
